a.text: Rheidol was built by W.G. Bagnall in Staffordshire, England.

b.text: The locomotive was originally built by W.G. Bagnalls.

a.text: The locomotive began working on the Plynlimon and Hafan Tramway in Wales.

b.text: Talybont was delivered to the Plynlimon and Hafan Tramway in August 1897.
Rheidol was scrapped at Swindon Works.
